issue.title: [BUG] read_file reports inverted line range when offset is past EOF
issue.body:
## Describe the Bug

`read_file` can report an inverted line range and render a phantom line number when the requested offset starts beyond the end of the file.

Before the fix, a 3-line file requested with an offset like `10` could produce output like:

```txt
test.txt (lines 10-3 of 3, 20 bytes)
    10→
```

That range is not meaningful because line 10 does not exist and the clamped end is line 3.

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Use `read_file` on a file with fewer lines than the requested offset.
2. Pass an offset beyond EOF, for example line `10` for a 3-line file.
3. Observe the formatted output header and line-numbered content.
4. The underlying helper can also be reproduced with `extractLinesWithLimit("a\nb\nc", 10, 5)`.

## Link to Minimal Reproducible Example

Regression coverage and fix are in https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17275.

## Expected Behavior

When the requested offset starts past EOF, the result should be represented as an explicit empty range, such as `lines 0-0 of 3`, and `read_file` should not render a phantom line number.

Real blank lines inside valid ranges should still keep their line number marker.

## Environment Information

- Package: `@mastra/core`
- Area: workspace file tools
- Affected code paths:
  - `packages/core/src/workspace/line-utils.ts`
  - `packages/core/src/workspace/tools/read-file.ts`
- Not provider-specific or browser-specific.

## Verification

- [x] I have searched the existing issues to make sure this is not a duplicate.
- [x] I have included sufficient information for the team to reproduce and understand the issue.

## Related

Fix PR: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17275

steps: Create a file named test.txt containing exactly three lines: `a`, `b`, `c`.
Use read_file on test.txt (a 3-line file) with offset 10 and show the output.
expected: Reading past EOF reports an explicit empty range such as `lines 0-0 of 3` and renders no line-number marker.
defect: The output header shows an inverted range `test.txt (lines 10-3 of 3, ...)` followed by a phantom line `10→`.
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17275 (commit 847ff1e0d94368d94b2e173e4e0908e115568ef3). Before the fix, extractLines in packages/core/src/workspace/line-utils.ts clamped the end of the requested range to the file length but kept the requested start, so an offset past EOF produced start > end (10 > 3) with empty content; read-file.ts then formatted that range into the header (`lines 10-3 of 3`) and called formatWithLineNumbers(result.content, result.lines.start), which renders a numbered marker `10→` for the empty content. The fix returns { content: '', lines: { start: 0, end: 0 } } when start > end and skips line numbering when no lines were extracted. The fix (2026-05-29) is first released in mastracode@0.21.2 (@mastra/core@1.38.0); the pinned revision mastracode@0.41.0 already contains it and no pre-fix mastracode release has the ACP entry (first in 0.25.0), so the case is pinned and is not expected to reproduce.
